title: GSM MAP: Fallback Application Context version on unmatched transactions
description:
Split the application context version preference into two preferences,
a boolean for whether to use the version from the TCAP transaction, if
available, and an enum for what version to use by default.

When the boolean is false, the version from the enum is always used;
if the boolean is true, the version from the enum is used as a fallback
if the version is not available, e.g. where the capture file does not
contain the complete transaction or for any other reason.

Default using the version from TCAP to true (this was the default for
the old preference), and the fallback version to v3. Removing the old
default value from the enum isn't a problem for forwards compatibility,
because default values aren't written to the prefs file.

Fix #9643
